description: An ET41 with 25 fully loaded coal wagons (412W, 80 t each, G; about 2170 t) starts on level track with the rail friction at 0.3 of its normal (eu07.ini friction 0.3, as on wet leaves), and runs to the signal at stop 1000 m ahead. The train is to get going, keep moving and stop at the signal (#187: heavy trains slip, grip and snatch over and over and often don't get going).
